description: Declare a structural dependency: storyId is blocked by blockerStoryId, for the given reason. Adds one entry to the dependent story's blocked_by array. Idempotent on blockerStoryId — duplicate calls are safe. Emits a story.blocker_added audit row carrying identity, timestamp, and the reason. Use this when grooming surfaces a dependency (e.g., B.6.2 cannot ship until 2B.1's canonical stage identifier lands). The blocker's storyTitle is resolved authoritatively from the blocker's row at write-time; callers don't supply it.

blockerStoryId.description: UUID of the story that blocks the target (the blocker). Must exist in the same tenant.

reason.description: Why the blocker exists. Captured verbatim in the audit_log row so future readers (compliance review, forensic walks, prepare_implementation traversals) can reconstruct the rationale without re-asking.

storyId.description: UUID of the story being blocked (the dependent). The blocker relationship is recorded on this story's blocked_by array.

name: add_blocker
